Rae (CS): LotusBridge wants private/VPC cutover in 9 business days. Top open items: outbound TLS to their SIEM, KMS grant for our deploy role, CloudTrail retention to their S3, and mapping the log-write IAM role. Can we get a quick status?

Tom (Network): I'll publish the SNAT IP list + a mini runbook for firewall rules by EOD. We're planning NAT GW with fixed SNATs. If they have an egress proxy we'll need an explicit bypass for collector FQDNs.

Tom (Network): Quick validation step for LotusBridge: from a pod run `curl -sI https://siem.lotusbridge.internal` and paste output so we can verify TLS handshake and SNI.

Anya (Security): KMS: they must add a key policy allowing `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/lotus-redwood-deploy` with `kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey`. I'll post a concise policy snippet and a rotation note. Also ask if they require HSM-backed keys.

Marco (SRE): Logs: recommended path is CloudTrail + VPC flow logs -> S3 for retention. Alternate: TLS syslog to their SIEM. For S3 we need bucket name and either a bucket policy or an assume-role ARN for `redwood-log-writer`. If TLS, we need collector IP/port and cert fingerprint.

Marco (SRE): I can spin up a staging TLS endpoint for a smoke test tomorrow; will share the endpoint and cert fingerprint once ready.

Rae (CS): Risk note: regulatory date is firm. If KMS and egress not validated before the cutover window, they will escalate and consider delaying. Please prioritize SNAT IPs and the KMS snippet.

Tom (Network): Affirmative. SNAT IPs + runbook by EOD. Will include proxy troubleshooting steps.

Anya (Security): I'll drop the KMS policy snippet and short HSM/rotation checklist by EOD.

Marco (SRE): Staging collector + assume-role JSON tomorrow morning.

Rae (CS): Action summary: Tom: SNAT IPs/runbook (EOD); Anya: KMS policy + rotation note (EOD); Marco: staging collector + IAM spec (tomorrow AM); Rae: confirm HSM preference with LotusBridge and schedule enablement call (today).

infra-bot: notice: planned maintenance for redwood-staging-collector on 2024-10-05T02:00:00Z 15m window.

Rae (CS): Thanks team. Drop links here when ready and I'll send a consolidated email to the customer.
